Theorem
[Radial curvature equation]

Source: petersen:page-0110 ↗ def:pet-ch3-hessian-square-notation ↗ def:pet-ch3-curvature-tensor

1. ch3:3.2.2With $S,\operatorname {Hess}^2f$ as in subsection 2.1: egin{align} ( abla _{ abla f}S)(X)+S^2(X)- abla _X(S( abla f))& =-R(X, abla f) abla f,\ abla _{ abla f}\operatorname {Hess}f+\operatorname {Hess}^2f-\operatorname {Hess}\Big( frac 12| abla f|^2\Big)& =-R(\cdot , abla f, abla f,\cdot ),\ \mathcal L_{ abla f}\operatorname {Hess}f-\operatorname {Hess}^2f-\operatorname {Hess}\Big( frac 12| abla f|^2\Big)& =-R(\cdot , abla f, abla f,\cdot ). \end{align}
Proof

↗ thm:pet-ch3-radial-curvature-equation

\sketch Set $S(X)= abla _X abla f$ and expand the curvature definition. The product rule for $ abla S$ gives

\[ -R(X, abla f) abla f =( abla _{ abla f}S)(X)+S^2(X)- abla _X(S( abla f)). \]

Lowering an index and using $S( abla f)= abla ( frac 12| abla f|^2)$ gives the second formula. Since

\[ \mathcal L_{ abla f}\operatorname {Hess}f = abla _{ abla f}\operatorname {Hess}f+2\operatorname {Hess}^2f, \]

substitution gives the third.

□
